content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Albany

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders have different thresholds. Gather documentation of your project work to validate your experience before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course designed for working professionals. Attend sessions from anywhere—no commute required. Our active certified practitioners guide you through the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application across five days of interactive instruction.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal application directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee to secure your exam eligibility. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, domain-focused drills, and study strategies—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam at a testing center or online. Our instructors remain available to clarify challenging concepts before you test.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your credential, maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle. Stay current with continuing education, project leadership experience, and PMI involvement. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive edge in Albany's evolving job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
